card.title: BRYANSK
card.text: Bryansk was the center of partisan activity against the German invaders.
card.flavorText: The city of Bryansk was captured by the Germans in 1941 but during the occupation over 60,000 partisans operated in the region in and around the city, mainly from the Bryanskie Forests. The partisans managed to disrupt the German supply lines by blowing up railways and bridges as well as killing numerous German soldiers in combat. The city was finally liberated by the Red Army on 17 September in 1943.
